answer: The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the raven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the shale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
